definitionZh: 面具图像 CSS 属性设置一个元素用作遮罩层的图像,隐藏遮罩图像基于遮罩图像的α通道设定的元素部分,并根据遮罩-模度属性值,遮罩图像颜色的亮度.
sourceDefinition: The mask-image CSS property sets the image that is used as the mask layer for an element, hiding sections of the element on which the masking image is set based on the alpha channel of the mask image and, depending on the mask-mode property value, the luminance of the mask image's colors.
